name: Treasure Quest
desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Treasure Quest! Loot treasure, battle monsters, and complete unique quests as you and your friends become the ultimate treasure hunters! Fight as a Wizard, Warrior, or Archer in over a dozen unique dungeons!

⭐️ How To Play:
- Press the PLAY button to create a dungeon!
- Defeat bosses for new weapons & loot!
- Upgrade your weapons & skills to grow stronger!
- Level up to unlock new dungeons & other features!

🎮 Controls:
- Desktop: Click to attack, F to use your ability, & LShift to sprint!
- Mobile: Tap to attack, use your ability, & sprint!
- XBOX: X to attack, Y to use your ability, & LB to sprint!
- Playstation: Square to attack, Circle to use your ability, & L1 to sprint!

🤑 Roblox Premium Benefits: +25% Gold, +25% XP, +25% Luck, & claim AFK rewards 25% faster!
